reference_provenance.normalization: rho_star=(rho-rho1)/(rho2-rho1); x/lambda1, viscosity convention in Xu&Tang eqfollowingLdefinition. Native collision-frequency mfp is not substituted.

limitations: Reproduced experimental series, not original numerical data.
Reference temperature near300K does not assert a verified experimental pressure; nondimensional dilute-gas comparison uses stated n as scale choice.

review_required: Inspect discrepancy alongside sampling, mesh/time/domain sensitivity and the reproduced-marker reading envelope. No acceptance threshold has been invented.
scope: Independent low-enthalpy density-profile comparison of the fixed baseline nitrogen model, not validation of all cylinder temperatures, chemistry, surface interaction or high-Mach physics.
